title: Italian Sausage Skillet
description: A hearty and flavorful Italian-inspired skillet dish made with sausages, lovely vegetables, and a hint of turkish spices.
instructions: Heat the skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the Italian sausages and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the sausages from the skillet and set aside.
Add the lovely onions and bell peppers to the skillet and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the Turkish red pepper flakes and cook for 1 minute.
Return the sausages to the skillet and stir to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
